what_was_implemented: src/cfd_sdf/stage_v_domain_preflight.py: fail-closed fixed-domain binding check plus pre-mesh physical clearance preflight, with a versioned declared profile
src/cfd_sdf/sdf.py: build_fields now builds the Stage V field grid from the declared problem-spec domain (fail-closed on padding and on extents that are not integer multiples of the voxel)

src/cfd_sdf/openfoam.py + src/cfd_sdf/config.py: the declared grid.domain_bounds_m is carried from ProblemSpec through problem_spec_to_project_config, field generation, blockMesh rendering, and case_metadata.json

scripts/stage_t_filtered_ramp.py: mesh_sweep and phase_stagev_level run the preflight and write stage_v_domain_preflight.json before blockMesh/surfaceFeatureExtract/snappyHexMesh/simpleFoam and refuse (SystemExit, no launch) on failure

declared_profile.margin_rationale: Fixed physical length registered before judging new runs. The recorded P17 failure left on the order of one finest background cell (~0.0125 m) at the far-field top patch and produced 220 under-determined cells; the margin must be far above any achievable background cell width, not derived from cell counts.

no_launch_guarantee: The preflight artifacts were written without running blockMesh, surfaceFeatureExtract, snappyHexMesh, checkMesh, or simpleFoam; the rejected candidate class can no longer reach meshing through the wired script paths.

validation.results: 601 passed, 2 skipped (was 591 passed before this slice); added tests/test_stage_v_domain_preflight.py
validation.notes: test_generated_case_records_problem_provenance_and_mesh_refinement voxel changed 0.15 -> 0.1 because 0.15 does not divide the declared 1.6 m y extent; tests/test_stage_v_domain_preflight.py includes skip-gated fixtures for the two recorded candidate STLs (work/ paths, re-validated when present).

claims_supported: The Stage V far-field box is now bound to the declared ProblemSpec domain for the wired Stage V paths (contract).
The declared clearance profile rejects the recorded boundary-touching candidate class before any mesh command (capability, no-launch artifact).
claims_not_supported: No mesh quality, solver convergence, or target-physics claim.
No grid-independent downforce or ranking claim; P16 and WP3 remain open.
The 0.25 m margin is a declared physical length for this profile, not measured optimal clearance.
next: WP2/WP3: with the fixed domain, evaluate the step0 candidate's Stage V reference one factor at a time (pre-declared local refinement around body/wake, three qualified levels, Cd 0.02 relative and downforce 0.005 absolute bounds) before any ranking work.
